attchmntText: Integrated Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Country Condo’s Limited announced the approval of unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors met on 12 November 2026 to approve the results, statement of assets and liabilities, cash flow statement, and related party transaction disclosures. The financials were reviewed by M/s. P. Murali & Co., Chartered Accountants. For the three months ended 30 September 2026, net sales were Rs. 287.28 lakhs, and net profit after tax was Rs. 11.16 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.01. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, net sales were Rs. 697.76 lakhs, and net profit after tax was Rs. 26.97 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.03. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 stood at Rs. 4,727.22 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents were Rs. 124.40 lakhs. The company is engaged in real estate activity.

attchmntText: Country Condo's Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Country Condo’s Limited announced the Board of Directors meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The approval includes the Statement of Assets and Liabilities, Cash Flow Statement, and Related Party Transaction disclosures. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s. P. Murali & Co., Chartered Accountants. Net profit after tax for the quarter was 11.16 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.01. Total income for the quarter was 287.28 lakhs. Total expenditure was 273.18 lakhs. Profit before tax was 14.10 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 124.40 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 2:00 P.M. and concluded at 3:55 P.M. The Vice Chairman and CEO is D. Krishna Kumar Raju.
